title: Beyond Time
summary: Ha-Jun manipulates the River of Null Time to predict every attack of the Void Triumvirate, turning the battlefield over Seoul into an unassailable sovereign dance.

panels.shot: the sky over seoul filled with explosions of violet and green mana
panels.action: Overhead dogfights of dragons, shadow soldiers, and anti-matter missiles light up the stormy Seoul clouds.
panels.prose_en: Overhead dogfights of dragons, shadow soldiers, and anti-matter missiles light up the stormy Seoul clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Dregan, chhaya sainikon aur anti-mater misailon ki overhead dogfights tufani seoul baadalon ko roshan karti han.

panels.shot: second void sovereign 'morvath' swinging a 100-foot warhammer down
panels.action: Morvath, the Sovereign of Iron Decay, swings a hundred-foot titanium warhammer down at Ha-Jun at Mach 5.
panels.prose_en: Morvath, the Sovereign of Iron Decay, swings a hundred-foot titanium warhammer down at Ha-Jun at Mach 5.
panels.prose_hi: Iron deke ke samprabhu, morwath, Ha-Jun mein much 5 par ek sau foot ke titanium warhammer ko neeche ghumate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes glowing with golden chronal predictive rings
panels.action: Through the Eye of the Night and the Hourglass, Ha-Jun sees three ghost silhouettes showing where the hammer will land three seconds in the future.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Three seconds ahead... Your attack was already finished before you swung.

panels.prose_en: Through the Eye of the Night and the Hourglass, Ha-Jun sees three ghost silhouettes showing where the hammer will land three seconds in the future.
panels.prose_hi: Rat ki aankh aur ghante ke chashme ke madhyam se, Ha-Jun ko teen bhutiya akritiyan dikhai deti hain jo dikhati hain ki hathauda bhavishya mein teen second mein kahan girega.

panels.shot: ha-jun side-stepping with millimeters of clearance
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his head casually; the gargantuan hammer whistles past his ear, missing him by two millimeters.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tilts his head casually; the gargantuan hammer whistles past his ear, missing him by two millimeters.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun laparvahi se apna sir jhukata hai; vishalkay hathaude ne uske kaan ke paas se ct bajai, jisse wah do millimeter gayab ho gaya.

panels.shot: tae-jun flanking beneath the hammer strike with dual bronze blades
panels.action: Tae-Jun dives beneath the descending hammer shaft, slashing both bronze swords across Morvath's knee tendons.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun dives beneath the descending hammer shaft, slashing both bronze swords across Morvath's knee tendons.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun utarte hue hathaude ke shaft ke neeche gota lagata hai, aur donon kansya talwaron ko morwath ke ghutne ke kandara se kaat deta hai.

panels.shot: morvath roaring in pain as his 15-foot frame drops to one knee
panels.action: Morvath's knee buckles; golden coolant sprays as the titan drops to one knee on a floating skyscraper roof.

dialogue.speaker: morvath
dialogue.text: Insolent flies! You dare wound a Sovereign?!

panels.prose_en: Morvath's knee buckles; golden coolant sprays as the titan drops to one knee on a floating skyscraper roof.
panels.prose_hi: Morwath ka ghutna jhuk gaya; jaise hi titan ek tairti hui gaganchumbi imarat ki chhat par ek ghutne tak girta hai, sunhare shitalak ka chhidkav hota hai.

panels.shot: third void sovereign 'nyxara' casting twenty black hole spheres
panels.action: Nyxara, the Sovereign of Black Nebulas, gestures with four clawed hands, raining twenty miniature black holes at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: Nyxara, the Sovereign of Black Nebulas, gestures with four clawed hands, raining twenty miniature black holes at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Black nebulas ka shasak, niksara, char panje wale hathon se ishara karta hai, Ha-Jun par bees laghu black hole ki baarish karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun invoking chains of ruin to anchor the gravitational fields
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips Chains of Ruin outward, looping the heavy adamantine links around the black holes and redirecting their pull.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whips Chains of Ruin outward, looping the heavy adamantine links around the black holes and redirecting their pull.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chains off ruin ko bahar ki or ghumata hai, black hole ke charon or bhari adamentin link ko loop karta hai aur unke khinchav ko punarnirdeshit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hurling all twenty black holes straight back at nyxara
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips the chains; the twenty singularity spheres slingshot in a tight cluster straight into Nyxara's chest.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whips the chains; the twenty singularity spheres slingshot in a tight cluster straight into Nyxara's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun janjeeron ko kode maarta hai; bees vilakshanta wale gulel ek tang samuh mein sidhe naksara ki chhati mein ghus jaate han.

panels.shot: nyxara screeching as her own black holes implode against her armor
panels.action: Nyxara shrieks as her bone armor crumples under forty million tons of gravitational compression.
panels.prose_en: Nyxara shrieks as her bone armor crumples under forty million tons of gravitational compression.
panels.prose_hi: Jab chalis million ton gurutvakarshan sampidan ke tahat uski haddi ka kavach dhah jata hai, to niksara cheekhne lagti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun executing a synchronized pincer assault
panels.action: Moving like twin comets of black and gold, the brothers cross blades in an X-pattern across Morvath's chest.
panels.prose_en: Moving like twin comets of black and gold, the brothers cross blades in an X-pattern across Morvath's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Kale aur sone ke judwan dhumketuon ki tarah chalte hue, bhai morwath ki chhati par ek ex-patern mein blade paar karte han.

panels.shot: morvath torso exploding into grey ash and sparks
panels.action: Morvath shudders, his chest cavity blasted open; he collapses and disintegrates into a storm of grey ash.
panels.prose_en: Morvath shudders, his chest cavity blasted open; he collapses and disintegrates into a storm of grey ash.
panels.prose_hi: Morwath kamp utha, uski chhati ki guha khul gai; wah dhah jata hai aur dhusar raakh ke toofan mein bikhar jata hai.

panels.shot: zeron watching from his center throne his eyes narrowing with venom
panels.action: Zeron rises to his full height, drawing an 80-foot scythe of pure antimatter: 'Useless fools. I will slaughter you myself.'
panels.prose_en: Zeron rises to his full height, drawing an 80-foot scythe of pure antimatter: 'Useless fools. I will slaughter you myself.'.
panels.prose_hi: Zeron apni puri unchai tak uthta hai, shuddh antimatter ki 80 foot ki daranti khinchta hai: 'bekar murkh. main swayam tumhara vadh karunga.'

panels.shot: zeron teleporting directly before ha-jun with instantaneous speed
panels.action: Zeron vanishes and reappears zero inches from Ha-Jun's nose, swinging his scythe at Mach 20.
panels.prose_en: Zeron vanishes and reappears zero inches from Ha-Jun's nose, swinging his scythe at Mach 20.
panels.prose_hi: Zeron gayab ho jata hai aur Ha-Jun ki naak se shunya inch door phir se prakat hota hai, apni daranti ko mac 20 par ghumata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun blocking the scythe with the sanguine fang: seismic shockwave
panels.action: Blade meets scythe; the shockwave levels all glass windows across a ten-block radius in Yeouido.
panels.prose_en: Blade meets scythe; the shockwave levels all glass windows across a ten-block radius in Yeouido.
panels.prose_hi: Bled daranti se milta hai; shockwev yeouido mein das-block ke dayre mein sabhi kaanch ki khidkiyon ko samtal kar deti hai.

panels.shot: the two kings locking eyes across their glowing crossing blades
panels.action: Ha-Jun's royal violet eyes burn inches away from Zeron's glowing red oculars, neither yielding an inch.

dialogue.speaker: zeron
dialogue.text: You fight well for a half-breed mortal.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's royal violet eyes burn inches away from Zeron's glowing red oculars, neither yielding an inch.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki shahi baingani aankhen zeron ki chamakti lal aankhon se inch bhar door jalti han, na hi ek inch bhi jhukti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling cold and sharp: 'i'm not half-breed. i'm the whole thing.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun's smile cuts like ice: 'And you're standing on my front porch.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main half-breed nahi hoon. I am the True Demon Sovereign.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's smile cuts like ice: 'And you're standing on my front porch.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki muskan barf ki tarah katati hai: 'aur tum mere samne baramde par khade ho.'

panels.shot: ha-jun unleashing the ashen heart hellfire point blank
panels.action: The Ashen Heart detonates in Ha-Jun's chest; a point-blank volcanic cone of violet hellfire scorches Zeron's faceplate.
panels.prose_en: The Ashen Heart detonates in Ha-Jun's chest; a point-blank volcanic cone of violet hellfire scorches Zeron's faceplate.
panels.prose_hi: Ation heart Ha-Jun ki chhati mein futata hai; baingani narkankaal ka ek bindu-rikt jwalamukhi shanku zeron ke faceplate ko jhulsa deta hai.

panels.shot: zeron stumbling back his visor smoking and melted
panels.action: Zeron stumbles back through the clouds, cursing as his molten faceplate drips burning slag into the rain.
panels.prose_en: Zeron stumbles back through the clouds, cursing as his molten faceplate drips burning slag into the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Ziron baadalon ke madhyam se ladkhadata hua wapas laut aata hai, shaap deta hai kyonki uska pighla hua faceplate baarish mein jalta hua lava tapkata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun lunging from above driving both bronze blades into zeron wings
panels.action: Tae-Jun dives from a cloud bank, pinning Zeron's scythe-wings together with his enchanted bronze blades.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun dives from a cloud bank, pinning Zeron's scythe-wings together with his enchanted bronze blades.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ek cloud bank se gota lagata hai, zeron ke skith-pankhon ko apne mantramugdh kansya blade ke saath pin karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping forward channeling all ten relics into the sanguine fang
panels.action: Ha-Jun rockets forward; the Sanguine Fang expands into a 50-foot greatsword of pure cosmic starlight and blood.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rockets forward; the Sanguine Fang expands into a 50-foot greatsword of pure cosmic starlight and blood.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun rocket aage; senguin fang shuddh brahmandiya taron ki roshni aur khoon ki 50 foot ki mahan talwar mein vistarit hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun horizontal execution cleave through zeron neck
panels.action: A clean, horizontal line of blinding violet starlight shears cleanly through Zeron's 15-foot armored neck.
panels.prose_en: A clean, horizontal line of blinding violet starlight shears cleanly through Zeron's 15-foot armored neck.
panels.prose_hi: Zeron ki 15 foot ki bakhtarband gardan ke madhyam se chamakdar baingani taron ki roshni wali kainchi ki ek saf, kshaitij rekha saf-saf gujarti hai.

panels.shot: zeron severed head flying into the stormy sky eyes frozen in shock
panels.action: Zeron's giant horned helm spins into the storm clouds, his red oculars extinguishing in disbelief.
panels.prose_en: Zeron's giant horned helm spins into the storm clouds, his red oculars extinguishing in disbelief.
panels.prose_hi: Zeron ka vishal seeng wala patwar toofani baadalon mein ghumta hai, uski lal aankhen avishvas mein bujh jaati han.

panels.shot: zeron colossal headless body crashing down into the empty riverbed
panels.action: The 15-foot titan corpse hits the frozen river with a colossal seismic thud, bursting into harmless grey ash.
panels.prose_en: The 15-foot titan corpse hits the frozen river with a colossal seismic thud, bursting into harmless grey ash.
panels.prose_hi: 15 foot ka titan shav ek vishal bhukampiy dhamake ke saath jami hui nadi se takrata hai, jo hanirahit bhure raakh mein badal jata hai.

panels.shot: the remaining void monsters shrieking and routing in pure panic
panels.action: Seeing their supreme general beheaded, the remaining thousands of void beasts turn and flee toward the portals in terror.
panels.prose_en: Seeing their supreme general beheaded, the remaining thousands of void beasts turn and flee toward the portals in terror.
panels.prose_hi: Apne sarvochch senapati ka sir katte dekh, shesh hajaron shunya janwar bhaybhit hokar dwar ki or bhag gaye.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun landing side-by-side on the mapo bridge pillar
panels.action: The brothers touch down lightly on the bridge pillar, blades lowered as the rain cools their smoking armor.
panels.prose_en: The brothers touch down lightly on the bridge pillar, blades lowered as the rain cools their smoking armor.
panels.prose_hi: Bhai pul ke khambhe ko halke se chhute han, blade neeche ho jaate hain kyonki baarish unke dhumrapan kavach ko thanda kar deti hai.

panels.shot: citizens across seoul emerging from shelters cheering in wild celebration
panels.action: Millions of citizens across Seoul pour onto balconies and streets, waving and cheering for the two brothers.

dialogue.text: Seoul survived the first strike. The Triumvirate was broken.

panels.prose_en: Millions of citizens across Seoul pour onto balconies and streets, waving and cheering for the two brothers.
panels.prose_hi: Siyol bhar mein lakhon nagrik balkaniyon aur sadkon par khade hokar donon bhaiyon ke liye haath hila rahe hain aur unki jay-jaikar kar rahe han.

panels.shot: kuro looking up at the sky with dread in his ruby eyes
panels.action: Kuro's feathers ruffle in panic: 'Don't celebrate yet. Zeron and Morvath were only the vanguard heralds.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Look at the dimensional clouds. The Prime Sovereign is waking.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's feathers ruffle in panic: 'Don't celebrate yet. Zeron and Morvath were only the vanguard heralds.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ke pankh ghabrahat se fadfadane lage: 'abhi jashn mat manao. zeron aur morwath keval agrani agradoot the.'

panels.shot: the sky tearing open revealing a colossal crimson eye spanning the horizon
panels.action: A thousand-mile red eye opens across the entire sky above Earth: The Void Primordial Entity itself.

dialogue.text: THE PRIMORDIAL ENTITY — ROOT OF ALL DARKNESS.

panels.prose_en: A thousand-mile red eye opens across the entire sky above Earth: The Void Primordial Entity itself.
panels.prose_hi: Prithvi ke upar poore aakash mein ek hajar meal ki lal aankh khulti hai: swayam shunya aadim ikai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun looking up into the cosmic eye cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand shoulder-to-shoulder, their blades glowing as the final, ultimate war looms!

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Let it come. We will finish this together.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand shoulder-to-shoulder, their blades glowing as the final, ultimate war looms!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun kandhe se kandha milakar khade han, unke blade antim, antim yudh ke roop mein chamak rahe han!
